name: local-mail-merge-desktop
author: HKRC
description: Local Mail Merge Electron desktop client

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.publish:worker: dotnet publish ../LocalMailMerge.Worker/LocalMailMerge.Worker.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o ../LocalMailMerge.Worker/publish --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json
scripts.package: npm run publish:worker && npm run build && electron-forge package
scripts.make: npm run publish:worker && npm run build && electron-forge make
